annotations.title: What needs my attention on Fabrica

description: One ranked list of everything waiting on the connected person on Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet): loans past or near maturity and offers waiting on their properties first, then steps of properties they are adding that wait on them, then fees to approve, then checks on their live properties (property taxes, owner contact, recovery status) and removals in progress. Each item has its kind, property, title, why, due date when known, the link where it is done and who acts. Fees and checks cover up to 20 live properties per call. checked lists what was read, so an empty list means nothing was found there. Reads only; uses the portfolio:read and onramp:read grants and skips what the connection lacks.
